user.title: Home 3D
user.description: Adds a sidebar page where you draw your home and see it in 3D.

ask.name: Ask the house
ask.description: Hands a sentence to the open Home 3D views: "Show the living room" shows it, questions are answered by the installed modules ("What is open?"). The first view that understands answers.

text.name: Sentence
text.description: What to show or ask, as you would say it.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: Only the view with this screen name reacts (set in the view's settings or the card's option screen). Empty: every open view.

speak.name: Speak
speak.description: The view speaks its answer with Assist's text-to-speech (off: it only shows it).

init.title: Home 3D
init.description: Where Home 3D appears. The panel link and the dashboard card work either way, and you can still hide the entry for yourself in Home Assistant's own sidebar settings.

data_description.restore_picture_days: A background or screen picture that only an older restore point still uses is kept this many days after that restore point was made, then removed at the next start. A restore point whose picture has gone restores without it. 0 removes such pictures at once.
